turns.text:
This came back when I tried to link a patient, what's the problem?

{"error":{"code":"ABDM-1170","message":"Invalid ABHA address"}}

must_contain: ABDM-1170 means the ABHA address you sent is not one ABDM will accept
sandbox addresses end with @sbx and production addresses end with @abdm, so an address from one environment does not exist in the other
the fix is to check the suffix matches the environment you are calling, then check the address against NHA's policy and confirm the account exists before linking against it
notes: pasted form; response body is representative, not a recorded example for this code.
